title: Migration flow estimation/forecasting under shocks
statement: 從長期bilateral migration estimates中學得可泛化patterns，同時捕捉conflict、environmental與policy shocks造成的rapid regime changes。
known_result: 2026 Nature用deep learning分析四十年human migration，將長期patterns與快速shocks放入統一predictive setting。
open_gap: data reconstruction uncertainty、shock exogeneity、zero flows、country boundary changes與forecast horizon。
first_task: 用公開aggregate migration panel的小子集做time-blocked baseline，對比gravity model與simple neural model；shock years完全hold out。
validation_limits: prediction pattern不等於migration原因；不把模型作個人移民建議。
completion_criterion: 在未見years/country pairs，尤其shock periods，穩定改善baseline並量化failure regimes。
screening_note: 2026-09-28 初始有界文獻篩查。社會科學結果高度依賴population、platform、time period與identification assumptions；每輪需重查版本與反證。
screening_queries: deep learning four decades human migration 2026

sources.title: Deep learning four decades of human migration
